    "body": "Closes #158\n\n## Summary\n- Added thin-host detection helpers and guardrails in `src/cli/cli-server.ts` to branch server commands between checkout and thin-host layouts.\n- Synced CLI asset management via `syncComposeAssets` and thin-host drift reporting across server lifecycle commands.\n- Expanded `tests/cli-server.test.ts` to cover layout detection, asset syncing, and guard enforcement in thin-host mode.\n- Included the nginx `Caddyfile` in published CLI artifacts through the `package.json` files list.\n\n## Planning and execution docs\n- [Guardrails report](https://nearform.lastlight.dev/admin/?tab=artifacts&repo=nearform%2Flastlight&key=issue-158&doc=guardrails-report.md)\n- [Architect plan](https://nearform.lastlight.dev/admin/?tab=artifacts&repo=nearform%2Flastlight&key=issue-158&doc=architect-plan.md)\n- [Executor summary](https://nearform.lastlight.dev/admin/?tab=artifacts&repo=nearform%2Flastlight&key=issue-158&doc=executor-summary.md)\n- [Reviewer verdict](https://nearform.lastlight.dev/admin/?tab=artifacts&repo=nearform%2Flastlight&key=issue-158&doc=reviewer-verdict.md)\n- [Status](https://nearform.lastlight.dev/admin/?tab=artifacts&repo=nearform%2Flastlight&key=issue-158&doc=status.md)\n\n## Test results\n```\n$ npm run test\nTest Files  75 passed | 2 skipped (77)\n     Tests  1052 passed | 7 skipped (1059)\n\n$ npm run typecheck:test\n(no output; command succeeded)\n```",

    "body": "Closes #1\n\n## Summary\n- Adds a weekly continuous maintenance scan cron workflow for repository health checks.\n- Introduces a `maintenance-review` workflow and skill contract for dashboard issue creation, delta scans, dedupe, caps, and cleanup.\n- Grants the maintenance review workflow issues-write permissions so it can manage GitHub issues.\n- Adds workflow loader and permission mapping tests for the new maintenance review path.\n\n## Planning and execution docs\n- [Guardrails report](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/guardrails-report.md)\n- [Architect plan](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/architect-plan.md)\n- [Executor summary](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/executor-summary.md)\n- [Reviewer verdict](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/reviewer-verdict.md)\n- [Status](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/status.md)\n\n## Test results\nCommand: `npm test`\n\n```text\n> lastlight@0.1.15 test\n> vitest run\n\n\n RUN  v4.1.7 /home/agent/workspace/lastlight\n\n\n Test Files  22 passed (22)\n      Tests  401 passed | 1 todo (402)\n   Start at  15:01:52\n   Duration  4.99s (transform 524ms, setup 0ms, import 1.00s, tests 1.95s, environment 1ms)\n```\n\nNo lint command is configured in `package.json`; guardrails report marks linting as missing / not run.\n\nCommand: `npm run build`\n\n```text\n> lastlight@0.1.15 build\n> tsc\n```\n",

    "body": "Closes #1\n\n## Summary\n- Adds a weekly continuous maintenance scan cron workflow for repository health checks.\n- Introduces a `maintenance-review` workflow and skill contract for dashboard issue creation, delta scans, dedupe, caps, and cleanup.\n- Grants the maintenance review workflow issues-write permissions so it can manage GitHub issues.\n- Adds workflow loader and permission mapping tests for the new maintenance review path.\n\n## Planning and execution docs\n- [Guardrails report](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/guardrails-report.md)\n- [Architect plan](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/architect-plan.md)\n- [Executor summary](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/executor-summary.md)\n- [Reviewer verdict](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/reviewer-verdict.md)\n- [Status](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/status.md)\n\n## Test results\nCommand: `npm test`\n\n```text\n> lastlight@0.1.15 test\n> vitest run\n\n\n RUN  v4.1.7 /home/agent/workspace/lastlight\n\n\n Test Files  22 passed (22)\n      Tests  401 passed | 1 todo (402)\n   Start at  15:01:52\n   Duration  4.99s (transform 524ms, setup 0ms, import 1.00s, tests 1.95s, environment 1ms)\n```\n\nNo lint command is configured in `package.json`; guardrails report marks linting as missing / not run.\n\nCommand: `npm run build`\n\n```text\n> lastlight@0.1.15 build\n> tsc\n```\n",

    "body": "Closes #1\n\n## Summary\n- Adds a weekly continuous maintenance scan cron workflow for repository health checks.\n- Introduces a `maintenance-review` workflow and skill contract for dashboard issue creation, delta scans, dedupe, caps, and cleanup.\n- Grants the maintenance review workflow issues-write permissions so it can manage GitHub issues.\n- Adds workflow loader and permission mapping tests for the new maintenance review path.\n\n## Planning and execution docs\n- [Guardrails report](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/guardrails-report.md)\n- [Architect plan](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/architect-plan.md)\n- [Executor summary](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/executor-summary.md)\n- [Reviewer verdict](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/reviewer-verdict.md)\n- [Status](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/status.md)\n\n## Test results\nCommand: `npm test`\n\n```text\n> lastlight@0.1.15 test\n> vitest run\n\n\n RUN  v4.1.7 /home/agent/workspace/lastlight\n\n\n Test Files  22 passed (22)\n      Tests  401 passed | 1 todo (402)\n   Start at  15:01:52\n   Duration  4.99s (transform 524ms, setup 0ms, import 1.00s, tests 1.95s, environment 1ms)\n```\n\nNo lint command is configured in `package.json`; guardrails report marks linting as missing / not run.\n\nCommand: `npm run build`\n\n```text\n> lastlight@0.1.15 build\n> tsc\n```\n",

    "body": "Closes #1\n\n## Summary\n- Adds a weekly continuous maintenance scan cron workflow for repository health checks.\n- Introduces a `maintenance-review` workflow and skill contract for dashboard issue creation, delta scans, dedupe, caps, and cleanup.\n- Grants the maintenance review workflow issues-write permissions so it can manage GitHub issues.\n- Adds workflow loader and permission mapping tests for the new maintenance review path.\n\n## Planning and execution docs\n- [Guardrails report](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/guardrails-report.md)\n- [Architect plan](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/architect-plan.md)\n- [Executor summary](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/executor-summary.md)\n- [Reviewer verdict](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/reviewer-verdict.md)\n- [Status](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/status.md)\n\n## Test results\nCommand: `npm test`\n\n```text\n> lastlight@0.1.15 test\n> vitest run\n\n\n RUN  v4.1.7 /home/agent/workspace/lastlight\n\n\n Test Files  22 passed (22)\n      Tests  401 passed | 1 todo (402)\n   Start at  15:01:52\n   Duration  4.99s (transform 524ms, setup 0ms, import 1.00s, tests 1.95s, environment 1ms)\n```\n\nNo lint command is configured in `package.json`; guardrails report marks linting as missing / not run.\n\nCommand: `npm run build`\n\n```text\n> lastlight@0.1.15 build\n> tsc\n```\n",

    "body": "Closes #26\n\n## Summary\n- Added shared workflow YAML validation helpers and refactored loader validation to use them.\n- Routed Slack/message and issue-comment workflow authoring commands to a new `workflow-author` workflow.\n- Added classifier intent handling, repo-write permissions, prompts, and skill documentation for dynamic workflow authoring.\n- Updated chat guidance to preserve the no-write chat boundary while directing users to authoring commands.\n- Added coverage for validation, routing, prompt-injection flag propagation, unmanaged repos, permissions, and workflow-author prepopulation.\n\n## Planning and execution docs\n- [Guardrails report](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F26-feature-dynamic-workflow-authoring-let-u/.lastlight/issue-26/guardrails-report.md)\n- [Architect plan](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F26-feature-dynamic-workflow-authoring-let-u/.lastlight/issue-26/architect-plan.md)\n- [Executor summary](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F26-feature-dynamic-workflow-authoring-let-u/.lastlight/issue-26/executor-summary.md)\n- [Reviewer verdict](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F26-feature-dynamic-workflow-authoring-let-u/.lastlight/issue-26/reviewer-verdict.md)\n- [Status](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F26-feature-dynamic-workflow-authoring-let-u/.lastlight/issue-26/status.md)\n\n## Test results\nCommand: `npm test`\n\n```text\n> lastlight@0.1.15 test\n> vitest run\n\n\n RUN  v4.1.7 /home/agent/workspace/lastlight\n\n\n Test Files  25 passed (25)\n      Tests  457 passed | 1 todo (458)\n   Start at  06:18:41\n   Duration  5.47s (transform 583ms, setup 0ms, import 1.12s, tests 1.98s, environment 2ms)\n```\n\nLint: no lint command is configured.     "body": "Closes #1\n\n## Summary\n- Adds a weekly continuous maintenance scan cron workflow for repository health checks.\n- Introduces a `maintenance-review` workflow and skill contract for dashboard issue creation, delta scans, dedupe, caps, and cleanup.\n- Grants the maintenance review workflow issues-write permissions so it can manage GitHub issues.\n- Adds workflow loader and permission mapping tests for the new maintenance review path.\n\n## Planning and execution docs\n- [Guardrails report](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/guardrails-report.md)\n- [Architect plan](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/architect-plan.md)\n- [Executor summary](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/executor-summary.md)\n- [Reviewer verdict](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/reviewer-verdict.md)\n- [Status](https://github.com/cliftonc/lastlight/blob/lastlight%2F1-continuous-pressure-job/.lastlight/issue-1/status.md)\n\n## Test results\nCommand: `npm test`\n\n```text\n> lastlight@0.1.15 test\n> vitest run\n\n\n RUN  v4.1.7 /home/agent/workspace/lastlight\n\n\n Test Files  22 passed (22)\n      Tests  401 passed | 1 todo (402)\n   Start at  15:01:52\n   Duration  4.99s (transform 524ms, setup 0ms, import 1.00s, tests 1.95s, environment 1ms)\n```\n\nNo lint command is configured in `package.json`; guardrails report marks linting as missing / not run.\n\nCommand: `npm run build`\n\n```text\n> lastlight@0.1.15 build\n> tsc\n```\n",
